title: Are you guys that desperate??
body:
It is so annoying that I am being constantly bombarded with pop ups and notifications to buy the app. It’s too much. Every goddamn time I open the app. Uninstalling and getting anything else that isn’t constantly asking me for money.

Edit: You’d figure that an app that apparently is being updated would improve… But no. I paid to use this app a year ago for a supposedly “life time subscription” and they’re asking me for money again. It’s a SCAM. Don’t pay them.

title: SCAM ALERT!!! I want a refund!!!!
body:
I purchased a lifetime premium a few months ago and now premium features aregone. 

I tried to restore it, as they show that option, done it multiple times already and the confirmation screen appear but nothing changes after that. Or the waiting screen freeze. I tried to reboot the phone and delete the app and install again and nothing.

I tried to contact them through email and social media and not a single reply...! 

And to use premium now i need to buy a monthly subscription?!!! 

This is outrageous!! I want my money back!!!
